name: manual_bb0b87
claim: Retire a stale queued outbox record for a file that was delivered by another route with outbox-resolve --only <file> and the delivery evidence, never by flushing the whole outbox: a flush also sends every other queued item, including unreviewed broadcasts.

decisions.notes: A failed first drop left a queued record; the later successful drop did not clear it; outbox-resolve for that one file did, with no network call.

rationale: A failed first drop left a queued record; the later successful drop did not clear it; outbox-resolve for that one file did, with no network call.
